price.a: Pricing starts from 25 €/m² depending on ceiling type, plus 10 € per lamp and 5 € per pipe/wiring unit. Use the calculator above for an instant estimate.

time.a: A standard apartment ceiling is installed in a single working day. Larger commercial projects are scheduled in stages.

materials.a: Premium European PVC and fabric stretch films, certified gypsum boards, mineral and wood acoustic panels.

warranty.a: Yes — 10 years on materials and installation, with full documentation.

process.a: No. We use dust-free tools and protective covers, so your furniture stays in place.
